# Stablezact

> Stablezact is a crypto payments company focused on making crypto wallets usable at checkout for merchants, businesses, and payment companies.

Stablezact helps businesses accept crypto payments while receiving settlement in stablecoins or supported fiat currencies. The public website explains Stablezact at a marketing level, including the product value proposition, how the checkout flow works, merchant benefits, integration positioning, and customer FAQs.

This website is primarily a single-page marketing site rather than a documentation portal.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](/): Public marketing page covering what Stablezact does, how it works, who it is built for, integration positioning, ecosystem reach, merchant benefits, customer story, and FAQs.
- [LLMs Summary](/llms.txt): LLM-friendly summary of the public marketing site.

## Key Topics

- [Crypto payments at checkout](/): Public overview of adding crypto as a checkout option.
- [How Stablezact works](/): Public explanation of the wallet-based payment flow, payment validation, and merchant settlement.
- [Merchant benefits](/): Public messaging on simplicity, non-custodial design, instant settlement, and customer reach.
- [Integration positioning](/): Public overview of compatibility with existing business and payment workflows.
- [Ecosystem and reach](/): Public marketing content about wallets, tokens, networks, and supported business use cases.

## Notes

- This file summarizes the public marketing site only.
- Technical integration details, commercial terms, privacy terms, and product-specific obligations may be governed by separate documentation or agreements.
